name: Vitals extras
description: Additional Vitals health checks: update status, environment indicator, development modules and mail configuration.
project_description:
This module provides extra functionalities for the Vitals module. 

 Features 
 Currently, this module offers the following enhancements

 
 Update status ‐ Returns the update check interval and e-mail status. 
 Environment indicator ‐ Returns the name of the current environment, if the Environment Indicator module is enabled. 
 Development modules ‐ Returns the status for common development modules ( reroute_email (or symfony_mailer_reroute ), shield , devel , and stage_file_proxy ). 
 Mail settings ‐ Returns the provider & transport of the website e-mail settings. Should be compatible with symfony_mailer , swiftmailer , mailsystem , smtp , phpmailer_smtp . 
 
 Ideas / Roadmap 
 
 Extra security: Provide additional key that can be validated through the request header 
 Extra security: Limit requests from certain IP 
 
 Installation 
 
 Install and enable the Vitals Extras module (Vitals 2.2+ module is a dependency). 
 Visit /admin/config/services/vitals, and enable the extra Vitals checks. 
 
 Dependencies 
 Vitals 2.2+
